prompt:
Produce a square transparent 4x4 inventory atlas for the TANGMEN martial craft sect. EXACTLY sixteen distinct isolated objects in row-major order. Invisible equal cells with centers at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of both axes. Icons small with at least20% blank transparent margin INSIDE each cell, each silhouette no more than60% cell width or height. Leave broad transparent gutters; no object overlaps another or touches the outside canvas. Transparent alpha. Hand-painted chibi wuxia props, muted indigo and antique copper, ivory paper, subtle teal accent, gouache/watercolor surfaces, fine warm-brown outlines, upper-left lighting, slightly top-down 3/4 view. Ten manuscript icons must use distinctly different bindings, covers, clips, outlines, folded paper/scroll shapes. Any paper showing must be blank or show simple NON-TEXT diagrams only. Strictly NO words, NO writing, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO grid, NO borders, NO frame, NO glow. Mechanics are stylized fantasy inventory items, not realistic construction diagrams. Exactly preserve the following item silhouettes and order. Do not substitute modern objects. The jacket must be empty, no character.
Row-major content; numbers are ordering instructions, never appear in image:
1. Compact indigo manual with antique-copper corners and three offset throwing-dart silhouettes embossed on the cover.
2. Indigo folded diagram with antique-copper timing ticks, slender dart symbols arranged along separated arcs.
3. Indigo hard book case with antique-copper four-petal clasp and layered mechanism diagrams peeking from the edge.
4. Indigo loose-leaf sheets with antique-copper border and tiny clip, showing glove and narrow needle-case motifs.
5. Palm-sized indigo breathing book with a fine antique-copper clasp, central dot inside a simple circular ring.
6. Indigo ring-bound folio with antique-copper rings and three distinct geometric page tabs.
7. Deep-indigo hardbound book with an antique-copper string-shaped inlay and a narrow leather fastening strap.
8. Narrow indigo folded footwork chart, staggered antique-copper footprints on diagonals and a small four-petal corner mark.
9. Several long indigo slips held by an antique-copper clamp, corridor pillars and curved stepping paths drawn on them.
10. Thick indigo notebook with antique-copper spiral spine, a broken wooden test piece and inspection tabs tucked inside.
11. Half-open rectangular indigo leather case, antique-copper dividers and neatly arranged short leaf-shaped throwing darts.
12. Indigo forearm bracer enclosing folded antique-copper wing-like supports, closed configuration with a prominent circular safety clasp.
13. Indigo short martial jacket with antique-copper fasteners and flat organized tool pouches along the waist.
14. Antique-copper four-petal workshop token, indigo hanging cord and a small square registration notch.
15. Small indigo cloth pouch with antique-copper ring, mist-teal wax seal and a pale powder-cloud emblem.
16. Flat deep-indigo wooden blueprint case partly open, antique-copper four-petal lock and layered ivory diagrams protruding.
visual_review: 已逐格目視確認16件，靛青／古銅配色，書冊輪廓、飛鏢匣、護臂、分袋短衣、信物、補給袋與母圖匣可辨。完整剪影分離且外緣未裁切，書頁採幾何示意，無可讀標籤。取樣仍應以透明間隙測量，不能假設固定留白百分比。
